author: DgSy
content:
Plan: Implementing M4 climate in 6 commits, one per kernel+test group:
1. Climate types + seasonal solar forcing + Coriolis
2. GCM atmospheric model (2-layer advection)
3. Temperature kernel (lapse rate + albedo)
4. Ocean currents (gyre dynamics + SST)
5. Orographic precipitation (upwind trace + rain shadow)
6. Whittaker biomes + soil fertility + climate pipeline + worker integration
All CPU-side matching hydrology pattern. WGSL shaders are reference for future GPU.
